environment: Isolated MongoDB; session and ownership integration
checks: Registration hashes passwords and stores only a digest of an HttpOnly session token
Bad account input, duplicate emails, unexpected identity fields, and overlong passwords are rejected
Login rotates sessions and logout revokes replay of the old cookie
Expired sessions, malformed tokens, and deleted accounts cannot access a journal
Every application data endpoint requires a valid session
Two accounts have independent lists, counts, overdue counts, duplicates, and company sequences
Guessing another owner ID cannot read, edit, delete, or transition their application
Unowned legacy rows and old shared collections are never assigned to a new account
Cross-origin mutations are blocked and account attempts are rate limited
Production sessions use Secure cookies and public exam database configuration is rejected
